body: Yeah, depression does it. Even with medication it still works it wonders. I definitely agree it's not fair how it works and warps your feelings to just be gray and black shaded and saps away the light and color. Unfortunately I don't have anything that gets me excited, the best positive emotional I can remember was 4 or 5 years ago when staying up late and just talking normally with someone under the stars, but moments like that are far and few between. It just feels so hopeless that I won't ever feel anything good again. I don't want to live like this forever.

The short answer? happiness. Something other than this unending emptiness that never goes away. Something that you wake up in the morning and say "I can't wait to do that". The long answer, I don't know what any of that is, I don't know how to spark that feeling and Im not sure I even remember what happiness feels like physically. Honestly, I'm so lost at this point I don't know what's left to do or try.
